A bipedal wolf creature with thick, shaggy charcoal-grey fur. Intense, glowing amber eyes. Apparent age adult with a feral, focused expression. Muscular, athletic canine build. Wears tattered, olive-green boxing wraps around the wrists and ankles. Signature details include sharp white claws on four-fingered hands and a long, bushy charcoal-grey tail.
BODY COLOR: charcoal-grey
